official_sources.supports: Capital minima and aggregate output floor
LCR normal-time threshold and buffer use
Stressed outflows and 75% aggregate inflow cap
Finalising Basel III and replacing legacy operational risk approaches

corrections_and_clarifications: PDF page54 has sqrt(1-rho^2); use sqrt(1-rho) consistent with latent asset-correlation model and CRE31.
PDF page54 PD(99.9%) values 3.78%/17.86% are stressed PD minus ordinary PD, not stressed PD itself.
Separate loss quantile from unexpected loss above EL; do not subtract EL twice.
CCyB is jurisdiction-dependent, generally 0-2.5% within the framework and may exceed that range; not fixed2.5%.
4.5/6/8% minima are nested; separate AT1 1.5% and Tier2 2% issuance not mandatory.
Common equity is equity, not accounting liabilities; regulatory capital is not a stock of cash.
Euler risk contribution includes exposure weight times marginal derivative.
Legacy operational methodology menu and bank/deposit-insurance snapshots not presented as current rules.

capital.capital_buffer_scope: conservation buffer only; other buffers excluded

floor.scope: aggregate illustration at fully phased-in reference; not a claim of current local implementation

lcr.scope: inputs already eligible/weighted, no special exemptions

nsfr.weights: Assigned purely to illustrate arithmetic, not a regulatory classification lookup

irb.model: Nondefaulted non-SME corporate, no financial institution correlation multiplier
irb.omitted: historical1.06, input eligibility checks/floors except UI range, output floor, buffers, provisions comparison and model permission
